snippet.title: Ezalm : Magic's Memory | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
A narrative-driven action RPG where your combat style depends on the elemental magic you choose. Lost in a forgotten region, unravel the mysteries of ancient peoples to find your way back to Ezalm.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3744470/Ezalm__Magics_Memory/

Music: Chasing the Traitor, part two by Vindsvept. Modified music released under CC-BY 4.0.
